summary: Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 This bill modifies federal permitting processes to expedite a wide range of projects. It also excludes from federal income tax certain damages from lawsuits relating to sexual acts. The bill limits the scope of the National Environmental Policy Act, including by  further limiting the types of federal actions that trigger environmental review, and exempting additional types of projects from environmental review. The bill also limits permit obligations under the Clean Water Act, including by narrowing the scope of review for water quality certifications, extending the term for permits issued under the National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System, and limiting the time period for review of permits for discharges of dredged or fill materials.
